substitution_equation_labels.source_format: Two stacked equation rows; each row contains its (1)/(2) label after a 2em mspace. Labels and corresponding equations are red/blue.
substitution_equation_labels.fault: mtable semicolon joining loses rows; ignored mspace merges each equation RHS and its label, producing =0(1) / =0(2). These parenthesized digits are equation labels, not multiplicative factors.
substitution_equation_labels.repair_requirement: Restore separate aligned rows and separately spaced equation labels, preserving references (1)/(2) in prose. A generic row-split repair alone does not restore the lost label spacing.
